episode_summary: A listener-fact-filled episode ranges from Indonesian taboos and Canadian moose to a Fulham substitution with perfectly inverted names and Denmark’s Louisiana Museum named for three Louises. The hosts riff on pronunciations, sports, and museum naming quirks while sharing a rapid-fire stream of curious submissions.
